support.notes: Windows 真机探测 2026-11-15（MAC e8:55:40:e1:0b:c5，见 docs/device-identity.md）：GATT 型号号读回 RC001、制造商 MIOM、序列号 250513、硬件 V2.0、固件 2671、软件 A.6.0.3；PnP VID 0x2717 / PID 0x32B8 / REV 0x00A4；9 个 GATT 服务与 ATVV 与 RC003/ARN9 完全一致；电池服务没有 0x2BED 额外特征（同 ARN9，不同 RC003）。按键布局与 RC003 一致：12 键、含 TV 键（2026-11-15 用户实机确认）。RC001 是独立 SKU，不等于 ARN9。2026-11-15 12:03 两次真实语音会话通过（36,000 / 108,720 采样，输入法均 verdict=reacted）；语音热键必须与微信输入法实际快捷键一致（默认 Ctrl+Win），不一致时输入法完全无响应。

transports.notes: ATVV service AB5E0001 with the same 0002 write / 0003 notify / 0004 notify characteristic set as RC003 and ARN9. Live voice sessions verified on 2026-11-15: 36,000 and 108,720 samples at about 15.0 kHz, with the IME reacting on both attempts.

HID identity confirmed on 2026-11-15: VID 0x2717 / PID 0x32B8 / REV 0x00A4, the same hardware ID as RC003 and ARN9. Layout matches RC003: 12 keys including TV, confirmed on the physical remote on 2026-11-15. The HID report descriptor is not readable from user mode, so key capture keeps using the RC003 path (Raw Input plus enhanced capture).

protocols.notes: ATVV is used by the Windows product; model-specific capability details are pending profile verification.

platforms.notes: Upstream tracks the ordinary model as ARN9. The RC001/ARN9 relationship must be verified before claiming macOS support under this ID.
Basic voice and button support exists in the migrated Windows implementation; this profile is not yet a runtime source of truth.
No Linux adapter has been implemented.

notes: remote_model_from_model_number maps ARN9 to RemoteModel::Arn9 and RC001 to RemoteModel::Rc001, so the earlier ARN9/RC003 conflict is resolved. RC001 currently gets the 12-key PROFILE_BUTTONS layout (TV key included); switch it to an 11-key layout only if the physical remote turns out to have no TV key.
